name: edit_transaction
description: Transaction-based file editing with atomic commit/rollback. Typical workflow: 1) action='begin' to start transaction (returns txnId), 2) action='edit' or 'edit_multi' to stage changes, 3) action='commit' to apply or 'rollback' to discard. Supports atomic=true (all-or-nothing) for edit_multi. Uses file backup approach (no git dependency). Backups stored in .ai-transactions/.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory.

txn_id.description: Transaction ID (required for edit, edit_multi, commit, rollback, info).

file.description: Single file path relative to workspace_dir (required for action=edit).

files.description: Multiple file paths relative to workspace_dir (required for action=edit_multi).

edits.description: Array of edits (required for edit, edit_multi).
